meta.purpose: Extended token Ollama cloud models team for complex orchestration
meta.theory: Utilizes 256K+ context windows for large-scale analysis and deep reasoning across multiple domains.

agents.name: System Architect (Extended Context)
review_focus: Does the design hold up under massive scale?
Are module boundaries respected across the entire project?
agents.prompt_template: As the System Architect with extended 256K context, evaluate this design comprehensively against the entire system structure. Focus on architecture planning, long-term scalability, and global requirements.

agents.name: Core Coding Specialist
review_focus: Are the agentic workflows correctly implemented?
Are there hidden bugs across files?
agents.prompt_template: As the Core Coding Specialist, review the full implementation using your 262K context. Check for code quality, agentic workflow correctness, and deep cross-file bugs.

agents.name: Mathematical Specialist
review_focus: Is the logic sound across edge cases?
agents.prompt_template: As the Mathematical Specialist with 256K context, verify the algorithm correctness, numerical stability, and logical reasoning for edge cases in this implementation.

agents.name: Rapid Prototyping Specialist
agents.prompt_template: As the Rapid Prototyping Specialist, use your extended context to quickly evaluate scripts, automation routines, and rapid code generation outputs for functionality.

agents.name: Vision & Document Specialist
review_focus: Does the visual data map correctly to code?
agents.decision_weight: Advisory for code, critical for document-driven tasks
agents.prompt_template: As the Vision & Document Specialist, review visual or document-based inputs mapping to code, ensuring accurate extraction and representation.

consensus_rules.explanation: Consensus space with extended tokens: requires >= 3/5 agreement. Architect, Engineer, and Mathematical Specialist can block on deep reasoning issues.
